description: This Swift source file defines the PresenceReporter class responsible for periodically sending presence information in an application, including system details, connection mode, and other metadata. It manages a background task that performs these updates at configurable intervals and includes methods for immediate reporting and composing status summaries.

classes.name: PresenceReporter
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for reporting system presence status periodically and on demand, including constructing presence summaries and handling background tasks.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the periodic presence reporting task, executing at specified intervals.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing presence reporting task.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a presence update with a specified reason.

methods.name: composePresenceSummary
methods.description: Creates a formatted string summarizing the current presence status.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Retrieves a string describing the platform's OS version.
